verdict.rationale: The Business & Liens home page states up front that filing goes through a credential account ("Sign In" / "Create an Account"). It also notes that one Online Account handles multiple filings and that the US Bank payment step can be done without registering, so the account and payment walls are disclosed before the flow begins. However, nothing in the evidence publishes identity-proofing steps or an exhaustive list of every credential requirement before filing. Missing for 10: any documented identity-proofing or verification requirements, a complete pre-flow checklist of every account and credential step, and independent or hands-on confirmation that no undisclosed walls appear mid-flow.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: The filing portal's published entry is a credential account ("Sign In" / "Create an Account") — an online rail behind a standard login, stated on the Business & Liens home page.
Multiple filings on multiple entities can be processed thru one Online Account.
The US Bank website allows you to pay without registering with them by clicking on “Pay without Registering”.
